Definition: to clatter, i.e. slap (the hands together), clang (an instrument); by analogy, to drive (a nail or tent-pin, a dart, etc.); by implication, to become bondsman by handclasping)
BiblicalUsage: The word is to blow, to clap, to strike, most often to blow the trumpet. Zadok blew the trumpet and all the people said, God save king Solomon; the priests blew the trumpets at Jericho and the wall fell down flat; and Joel says to blow the trumpet in Zion and sound an alarm in God's holy mountain.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the trumpet is God's alarm and God's announcement in one breath, and His people are meant to hear it and act.
